sentences.text: RAG — Retrieval-Augmented Generation — works like an open-book exam.
Before answering, it searches your PDFs and notes — and finds the relevant pages.
It writes its answer from what it found — with sources, so it makes things up far less.
No RAG, it guesses from memory.
With RAG, it answers from your files.
That's how companies build chatbots that know their business.
Follow — I explain one AI idea simply every week.
